model: Hovering a stamp thumbnail applied brightness(), which is a CSS filter, for 300ms. The detail play button also blurred the hero image under it. Hover no longer filters the thumbnail, and the play button no longer blurs the hero.

noise.rule: 18 is round(300ms * 60fps / 1000) for one thumbnail. 120 is two play buttons times 60 frames, counted only while the hero image under them is changing. Not a sampled compositor trace. A visited stamp still uses grayscale.
